headline: ETF Rotation Analysis: Health Care and European Equities Maintain Leadership Amid Sector Divergences
market_regime: Defensive Sector Consolidation and Regional Equity Bifurcation
executive_summary: Quantitative analysis reveals persistent leadership in Health Care (XLV, IXJ) and European equity markets (FEZ, EPOL), accompanied by emerging strength in Medical Devices (IHI) and Aerospace & Defense (ITA). Conversely, Utilities (XLU) and Latin American equities (ILF, EWZ) continue to rotate downward. Significant within-sector divergences are evident across Industrials, Tech, and Consumer Discretionary, while U.S. Large-Cap Value (IWD) demonstrates sustained relative strength over U.S. Large-Cap Growth (IWF).

emerging_rotations.title: Medical Devices Relative Strength Improving
emerging_rotations.explanation: IHI holds a confirmed trend state of EMERGING with a score of 78.59, driven by a 20-bar score change of +60.07 despite a short-term 5-bar score change of -10.02. Relative strength is positive across horizons, showing +11.74 percentage points over 20 bars and +7.73 percentage points over 63 bars, with a 20-bar CMF of 0.276.

emerging_rotations.explanation: ITA is in a confirmed state of EMERGING with a rotation score of 72.31, advancing via a 20-bar score change of +43.60 and a 5-bar score change of +10.83. Relative strength is positive across both horizons, registering +7.20 percentage points over 20 bars and +10.41 percentage points over 63 bars.
